what_this_is: the paired R measurement (scratch/step6/gfxdraw/paired_gpu.py) in the Step 3 shard schema. The reference is interleaved with our own render round by round; only B=1024 and B=4096 were timed, so BATCH_SCALES has no B=1 to compare against here (it is 1,687-1,990x in sweep2/superseded_gpu2110/, whose numerator is sound).

provenance.official_renderer_timing: paired: reference burst and render burst alternating, median of the per-round readings

decode.absent: not measured on this node; pairing these frames/s with another host's decode would be a cross-host ratio, so `cores` is not computed from this shard and the row is therefore capped at GPU_FASTER whatever R is. The magnitude is 105-163, measured on gpu2110 in the same job family (see sweep2/superseded_gpu2110/). A shard with a same-node decode bar comes from SLURM 6353690.

only_the_current_arm_is_a_certification_: Only the arm that reflects the CURRENT tree is a certification row. certify.merge keys runs on (env, device, host, threads) with no slot for an arm, so a before/after pair from one host collides and one silently supersedes the other. The before arm -- the per-primitive path on CPU, the kernel switched off on GPU -- is a Step 6 internal comparison and lives in the paired_*.json it came from, which is not Step-3-shaped and is not a shard.
